description: This script automates the process of updating Node.js version references in build and Docker files associated with the Playwright project. It retrieves the latest LTS Node.js version, then updates build scripts and Dockerfiles to use this version.

methods.name: getDockerfilePaths
methods.description: Retrieves paths of Dockerfiles in a specified directory.

methods.name: getLatestNodeJsVersion
methods.description: Fetches the latest Node.js LTS version from Node.js official distribution index.

methods.name: replaceVersionInFile
methods.description: Replaces the version number in a file based on a provided regex.

methods.name: refreshBuildScriptVersionNumber
methods.description: Updates the Node.js version in the build script file.

methods.name: refreshDockerfileVersionNumber
methods.description: Updates the Node.js version in a Dockerfile.
